Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 19 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 24 September 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Metro Manila, Quezon, Rizal and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Pampanga, Tarlac(San Jose, Concepcion, Capas, Bamban, Tarlac City), Bulacan(San Miguel, San Ildefonso, San Rafael, Baliuag, Pulilan, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Plaridel), Nueva Ecija(San Antonio, Cabiao), Cavite(Maragondon, Ternate) and Batangas(Nasugbu) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
